name: year
description: First calendar year of the Australian financial year the publishing release is named for

name: source_release_id
description: Identifier of the release whose chart the row was read from

name: source_release_label
description: Name of the release whose chart the row was read from

name: series_release_id
description: Identifier of the release the plotted series reports
observations: The chart plots two vintages side by side, so this differs from source_release_id on roughly half the rows. That comparison is the chart's purpose

name: series_release_label
description: Name of the release the plotted series reports

name: payment_program
description: Major payment program the growth rate describes
observations: Interest was renamed PDI, for public debt interest, in the 2026-27 Budget; both are recorded as public_debt_interest

name: projection_period_start_year
description: First calendar year of the financial year the growth rate is measured from
observations: Taken from the chart note or title of the publishing release, which states a window for each plotted series. It is the series release's own financial year, except for ndis_medium_term_only

name: projection_period_end_year
description: First calendar year of the financial year the growth rate is measured to
observations: Ten years after the start year, except for ndis_medium_term_only, where the note gives a shorter window

name: growth_basis
description: Whether the growth rate is nominal or real
observations: Nominal throughout. The chart note compares these programs against nominal GDP growth and nothing in the chart is deflated

name: average_annual_growth_percent
description: Average annual growth in the program's payments over the projection period, in per cent
observations: Some releases publish one decimal place and others four; both are stored as published
